summary:
Business quality: Apple's TTM margins to 2023-12-30 are gross 45.0%, operating 30.8%, net 26.2% and free cash flow 27.7% [E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:margins], with ROE of 136.2% and ROA of 28.5% ranking at the 96th percentile of Information Technology peers and a quality composite at percentile 99 [E:frank:AAPL:2024-05-01:quality]. Cash conversion is strong: TTM operating cash flow of USD 116.4B against capex of only USD 9.564B [E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:operating_cash_flow][E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:capex].
Growth trajectory: TTM revenue slipped -0.5% year on year while operating income rose +4.1%, net income +6.0%, EPS +9.0% and free cash flow +9.6% [E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:growth], and the 3-year revenue CAGR of +9.5% a year sits only at percentile 45 with a growth composite at percentile 42 [E:frank:AAPL:2024-05-01:growth]. The latest quarter was the strongest of the series at USD 119.6B revenue and USD 2.18 diluted EPS [E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:revenue][E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:eps_diluted], so the trajectory is stabilising rather than compounding.
Valuation: at USD 2.63T market cap the stock trades at P/E 26.1 versus a sector median of 33.6 and its own median of 26.5 (percentile 48 of its history) [E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:market][E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:pe], with EV/EBITDA 20.7 below the sector median 22.4 and FCF yield 4.1% above the sector median 3.3% [E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:ev_ebitda][E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:fcf_yield]. P/S of 6.8 is modestly above both its own median of 6.6 and the sector median of 5.7 [E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:ps], and the value composite at percentile 56 is only mildly cheap [E:frank:AAPL:2024-05-01:value].
Balance-sheet risk: total debt of USD 108B against cash of USD 40.76B and equity of USD 74.1B gives debt/equity of 1.46 (percentile 82) but net debt/EBITDA of only 0.52 (percentile 42) [E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:total_debt][E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:cash_and_equivalents][E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:stockholders_equity][E:frank:AAPL:2024-05-01:leverage]. TTM free cash flow of USD 106.9B comfortably covers the debt load [E:rflag:AAPL:2024-05-01:fcf_debt].
Red flags: accruals, receivables, FCF-versus-debt and dilution checks are all CLEAR, with accruals at -4.4% of assets, receivables excess of -1.9 points and share count down -2.4% year on year [E:rflag:AAPL:2024-05-01:accruals][E:rflag:AAPL:2024-05-01:receivables][E:rflag:AAPL:2024-05-01:dilution]; the going-concern check is NOT EVALUATED for lack of MD&A text [E:rflag:AAPL:2024-05-01:going_concern].
What would change my mind: a return to revenue decline with margin compression, a P/E moving back toward its own high of 70.4 [E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:pe], or any accruals or receivables flag turning negative would flip the quality and valuation views; conversely, evidence of reaccelerating revenue growth would raise the growth signal.
risks: Revenue is flat to slightly down (-0.5% TTM) [E:fsum:AAPL:2023-12-30:growth], so earnings growth depends on margin expansion that may not persist.
Gross margin stability is imperfect (margin_stability -1.2%) [E:frank:AAPL:2024-05-01:quality], leaving room for mix-driven margin disappointment.
Debt/equity of 1.46 at percentile 82 [E:frank:AAPL:2024-05-01:leverage] leaves less room if cash generation weakens.
The going-concern check is NOT EVALUATED [E:rflag:AAPL:2024-05-01:going_concern], so that risk is unknown rather than cleared.
Valuation is only mid-range versus its own history (P/E percentile 48) [E:val:AAPL:2024-05-01:pe], so there is little margin of safety if growth stalls.
